scope: Integrated current-authority process interruption, storage isolation, fencing and exact-outcome qualification, including repair of server-side phase deadlines.

acceptance.criterion: Run real separately permissioned stores and separate primary/witness processes through every PREPARE/local-commit/remote-COMMIT/local-receipt boundary, including lost responses, restart and durable exact retries; prove already-local restrictions and absence of false success or overtaking.
acceptance.evidence: Eight primary transaction/receipt boundaries and PREPARE/COMMIT/ABORT record/head process kills demonstrate no false success, exact terminal reconciliation, live rollback proof and conservative restarted absence. Pending local revocation denies access, outage prevents overtaking, and a successor follows predecessor COMMIT. Actual primary database deletion retains acknowledged state or leaves unresolved PREPARE closed. Separate primary/witness JVMs run the SQL/fsync interruption matrix; exact/changed/reordered requests, gaps, tampering, signed unknown capability, foreign installation/trust, durable retries and stale writers are observed. Artifact/harness/source/configuration identities are bound. Same-host isolation does not qualify host/disk loss; identity/session and institutional obligations remain open.

acceptance.criterion: Qualify complete fenced enrollment from preexisting restrictive authority and unchanged legacy history; an empty witness, stale primary, unknown capability, altered trust, foreign installation, gap, reordered record or tampered payload must fail closed.
acceptance.evidence: Signed TLS journal/store vectors and current regression pass. Separate primary/witness/operator UIDs, protected volumes, cross-mounted permission denials, separate SQL runtime role and independently held key bundles are observed. Restrictive enrollment retains revoked grants/credentials, inactive principals, lease status, immutable history and scientific identity; ENROLL record/head crashes resume the exact retained checkpoint. The versioned capability inventory and redacted diagnostics are exercised by current source and package checks. Unknown capability/producer, valid alternate signing pin, foreign installation, empty witness and incompatible state refuse admission. Existing local event identities remain LocalOnly; pending/unknown/durable responses remain explicit. Legacy organization recovery stays blocked.

acceptance.criterion: Advance a durable recovery barrier with a fresh challenge, prove independent old-writer fencing and permit/drain limits, and verify lost primary with unresolved PREPARE keeps recovery closed. Do not infer computer/disk survival from same-host fixtures.
acceptance.evidence: Fresh signed recovery barriers survive record/head kills and exact retries. The running admission client and actual packaged HTTP server are fenced with the local database epoch unchanged; restarted old service fails. The held backend transaction drains within the five-second permit plus recorded 0.25-second polling tolerance and its effects roll back. A separate actual stalled SQL acknowledgement insertion qualifies the unwrapped production finalizer: it drains within its own server-enforced five-second deadline plus recorded scheduling tolerance, returns pending and preserves the local restriction for exact resolution. Current authorization regression remains passing.

acceptance.criterion: Build the current installable artifact and run appropriate service/runtime-role, historical-upgrade and authority regression checks. Bind source, artifact, protected configuration identities and observed fault-matrix outcomes in receipts, without retaining secrets.
acceptance.evidence: The current artifact passes 250 authority/service/reference tests, 28 packaged checks, the retained historical upgrade and 33 distinct integrated process cases. The actual HTTP service classpath contains artifact JARs only; the test harness is absent from every service JAR.

acceptance.criterion: Review every unchanged parent O03.6 acceptance criterion against observed evidence. Close neither the parent nor downstream restore gates if any criterion is failed or not run; preserve O03.2 full identity/session and O03.3/SITE01 institutional obligations.
acceptance.evidence: parent-acceptance-review.json maps all six unchanged parent criteria to observed source, artifact and fault outcomes. Backup, restore/replay, complete identity/session, continuous delivery and institutional work remain open.

historicalUpgrade.organizationBootstrap: explicit reviewed mapping; same genesis on retry; private placement; legacy recovery fenced

verification.counting: Latest passing regression reports; 33 distinct process case names across the current-artifact matrix and finalizer runs. Repeated setup is counted once. Initial failed fixture attempts are retained, not counted as passes.

limitations: Same Docker host/physical disk; no off-host persistence, physical power-loss or institutional approval claim.
Independent policy mode requires PostgreSQL 17 transaction_timeout; older versions refuse independent admission.
No barrier release, policy replay or organization restore: H03.1 and O03.7/O03.8 remain required.
Current nineteen authority kinds only; full identity/session/lifecycle and institutional qualification remain O03.2/O03.3/SITE01.
F03.4 retains continuous byte-stream and external-worker checks; this qualifies SQL admission and actual API authentication.
H04.2 retains scale/performance qualification; five-second SQL permits and the bounded finalization phase keep their documented availability limits.
Synthetic keys and data; the Docker/database operator is trusted. Test-only JDBC/after-force controls are separate from the service artifact.
